site_snapshot.basis: current committed cleaned New Zealand places of worship

source_datasets.name: 2023 Census totals by topic for individuals by SA2 (part 1, clipped to coastline)
source_datasets.citation: Stats NZ 2023 Census totals by topic for individuals by SA2, accessed via the Stats NZ ArcGIS feature service.
source_datasets.redistribution_limits: Attribute Stats NZ and preserve source context.
source_datasets.notes: Counts are subject to Stats NZ confidentiality rules: random rounding to base 3, with -999 marking suppressed cells.

source_datasets.name: Current cleaned New Zealand places of worship
source_datasets.provider: OpenStreetMap contributors and project cleaning pipeline
source_datasets.citation: OpenStreetMap contributors, cleaned by the Places of Worship project.
source_datasets.notes: Current committed site snapshot; not a historical count for each census year.

indicators.label: Religion-response denominator
indicators.description: People with a stated religious-affiliation response in the area and census year.
indicators.method: Read from the Total stated field of the SA2 census extract.
indicators.spatial_coverage: New Zealand statistical area 2, 2023 boundary set
indicators.quality_notes: 2013 and 2018 counts were re-aggregated by Stats NZ onto 2023 SA2 boundaries. Counts are random-rounded to base 3 by Stats NZ; cells below the confidentiality threshold arrive suppressed. Rows with a stated-response denominator under 100 carry the rr3_small_denominator flag and should be washed out rather than read as precise.

indicators.label: Religious affiliation
indicators.description: Share of people with a stated religion response who reported a religious affiliation.
indicators.method: Calculated as 100 * (Total stated - No religion) / Total stated.
indicators.spatial_coverage: New Zealand statistical area 2, 2023 boundary set
indicators.quality_notes: Counts are random-rounded to base 3 by Stats NZ; cells below the confidentiality threshold arrive suppressed. Rows with a stated-response denominator under 100 carry the rr3_small_denominator flag and should be washed out rather than read as precise.

indicators.label: No religion
indicators.description: Share of people with a stated religion response who reported no religion.
indicators.method: Calculated as 100 * No religion / Total stated.
indicators.spatial_coverage: New Zealand statistical area 2, 2023 boundary set
indicators.quality_notes: Counts are random-rounded to base 3 by Stats NZ; cells below the confidentiality threshold arrive suppressed. Rows with a stated-response denominator under 100 carry the rr3_small_denominator flag and should be washed out rather than read as precise.

indicators.label: Places of worship
indicators.description: Number of current committed places of worship assigned to the area.
indicators.method: Point-in-polygon assignment from current cleaned site coordinates to the committed generalised 2023 SA2 boundaries (about 40 m tolerance), so a place within that distance of a boundary may sit in the neighbouring area.
indicators.spatial_coverage: New Zealand statistical area 2, 2023 boundary set
indicators.quality_notes: Current place counts are repeated across census years and should not be interpreted as historical counts.

indicators.label: Places per 10,000 residents
indicators.description: Current places of worship per 10,000 people in the religion-response denominator.
indicators.method: Calculated as 10000 * current place count / Total stated.
indicators.spatial_coverage: New Zealand statistical area 2, 2023 boundary set
indicators.quality_notes: Combines current site counts with census-year denominators. Counts are random-rounded to base 3 by Stats NZ; cells below the confidentiality threshold arrive suppressed. Rows with a stated-response denominator under 100 carry the rr3_small_denominator flag and should be washed out rather than read as precise.

indicators.label: Place density
indicators.description: Current places of worship per square kilometre of land area.
indicators.method: Calculated as current place count / LAND_AREA_SQ_KM from the Stats NZ feature service.
indicators.spatial_coverage: New Zealand statistical area 2, 2023 boundary set
indicators.quality_notes: Uses Stats NZ official land area; oceanic SA2 units are not part of the coastline-clipped layer.

visual_layers.label: Religious affiliation %
visual_layers.aggregation_rule: precomputed by SA2 and census year
visual_layers.notes: Wash out rows flagged rr3_small_denominator or suppressed_denominator.

visual_layers.label: No religion %
visual_layers.aggregation_rule: precomputed by SA2 and census year
visual_layers.notes: Wash out rows flagged rr3_small_denominator or suppressed_denominator.

visual_layers.label: Places per 10,000 residents
visual_layers.description: Current places of worship per 10,000 people in the religion-response denominator.
visual_layers.aggregation_rule: current place count divided by census-year denominator
visual_layers.notes: Use with caution because current place counts are repeated across census years.

visual_layers.label: Place density
visual_layers.description: Current places of worship per square kilometre.
visual_layers.aggregation_rule: current place count divided by land area

constants.population_total_basis: total people with a stated religious-affiliation response
